data.title: Full-Stack Engineer
data.fitReason: Direct match for their proven React + TypeScript frontend and Node.js + Fastify backend experience. 3 years fintech experience demonstrates ability to handle full-stack responsibilities in complex, regulated environments. Performance optimization skills directly applicable to end-to-end system improvements.

data.title: Frontend Engineer - React
data.fitReason: Core expertise in React and TypeScript with quantified performance optimization results (40% load time reduction). 3 years specialized fintech experience building trading dashboards. Mentorship of 2 juniors shows readiness for mid-level responsibilities. Tailwind and CI/CD skills enhance candidacy.

data.title: Backend Engineer - Node.js
data.fitReason: Demonstrated Node.js and Fastify experience built during last year at fintech company. PostgreSQL database skills and understanding of fintech systems architecture. CI/CD knowledge indicates DevOps awareness. Less deep than frontend expertise but strong enough for mid-level backend role.

data.title: Fintech Software Engineer
data.fitReason: 3 years specialized domain expertise in fintech with proven understanding of trading systems, real-time data requirements, and performance-critical applications. Full-stack capability across frontend and backend. Knowledge transfer and mentorship demonstrate maturity for fintech-specific roles.

data.title: UI/Frontend Developer
data.fitReason: Strong React and TypeScript expertise with Tailwind CSS for modern UI development. 3 years building trading dashboards requires deep UI/UX performance thinking. Mentorship of juniors shows ability to guide UI component decisions and best practices.

data.title: Performance Engineer
data.fitReason: Quantifiable track record of performance optimization (40% load time reduction on critical trading systems). Full-stack understanding enables end-to-end performance improvements. React, TypeScript, and Node.js proficiency allows performance work across entire stack.

data.title: Technical Lead - Frontend
data.fitReason: 2 years mentorship experience with 2 juniors while maintaining IC contributions demonstrates leadership foundation. React and TypeScript mastery provides technical credibility. Performance optimization expertise and fintech domain knowledge enable strategic technical decisions. Slight stretch but realistic with emphasis on mentorship achievements.

data.title: Full-Stack Developer - Trading Platforms
data.fitReason: Specialized role matching their exact background: 3 years building trading dashboards with React, Node.js backend, and performance optimization expertise. Direct domain experience with regulated financial systems. Rare combination of full-stack capability in trading-specific context.

data.title: Application Engineer - FinTech
data.fitReason: Bridges technical implementation and business requirements understanding built through 3 years fintech experience. Full-stack skills enable evaluation of technical feasibility. Mentorship experience shows ability to communicate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

data.title: Software Engineer - Design Systems
data.fitReason: Explicit interest in design systems combined with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind expertise. 3 years building consistent trading dashboard UI components provides foundation for design system thinking. Mentorship of juniors shows ability to standardize and document component patterns.
